rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I or II accredited by ACCME, or sponsored by an international, national or state medical society meeting ACCME standards; accredited training programs (50 credits per full-time year); up to 10 credits for uncompensated record review as a Board designee
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from CME at the first renewal after initial licensure or reinstatement; New Physician Orientation must be completed before the first renewal.
rules.alternatives: CME requirement deemed met by an active time-limited certification from an ABMS member board, AOA certifying board, Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or College of Family Physicians of Canada, with proof of maintenance dated within 5 years of renewal.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; send documents only if selected for audit. Keep CME documentation 6 years. Penalty up to $100 per missing CME credit.

topics.who: All licensees renewing after April 1, 2026: one-time implicit bias and structural racism training (ACCME-accredited or board-recognized; OMHHD lists)

rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs. Licenses expire September 30; the 2026 cycle covered last names A-L. No grace period after expiry. CDS prescribers must also register with the PDMP (separate CDS license). Renewal fee $512 = $436 renewal + $50 physician rehabilitation/peer review + $26 MHCC assessment (MHCC part may change).
rules.legal_basis: COMAR 10.32.01.10; implicit bias: Health Occupations Article §1-225
